# A balanced recursive zero test; each half must be zero.
def ISZERO<t>(a):
    assert t >= 1 and (t & (t - 1)) == 0
    if t == 1:
        x = bits(a, 1)
        return 1 ^ x[0]
    x = bits(a, t)
    k = t // 2
    lo = ISZERO<k>(pack(x[:k]))
    hi = ISZERO<k>(pack(x[k:]))
    return lo & hi

return ISZERO<t>(a)
